steps.title: Define 3D Clock Requirements and Design Specs
steps.description: Establish key aesthetic goals including real-time perspective rendering, user drag gestures, and physical accelerometer tilt integration.

steps.title: Configure Build System & Compatibility Settings
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with target SDK 34, JDK 17, and AGP 8.3.2 parameters matching compilation pipelines perfectly.

steps.title: Define App Namespaces and Permissions
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with system vibrator permissions and lock activity to portrait orientation for a refined user experience.

steps.title: Create Metallic App Background Asset
steps.description: Formulate a sleek radial dark gradient background styling representing futuristic technical glass overlays.

steps.title: Establish Glassmorphic Dashboard Containers
steps.description: Design an elegant semi-transparent layout shape with high-contrast glowing rims representing premium dashboard cards.

steps.title: Design Toggle Navigation Tab States
steps.description: Generate drawable selectors and background borders to signal selected navigation modes visually.

steps.title: Design Interactive Custom Theme Selector Styles
steps.description: Create selector shapes supporting dynamic glowing highlight outlines for the active dial customization skin.

steps.title: Build Action and Navigation Controls Drawables
steps.description: Design clean gradient button drawables for Start, Pause, and Reset chronograph mechanisms.

steps.title: Construct Dashboard Activity Main Layout
steps.description: Structure the main user interface with standard relative layouts, encapsulating header, primary clock rendering viewport, and dashboard cards.

steps.title: Create Core 3D Clock Rendering View
steps.description: Create the custom Clock3DView class with robust Canvas setups and standard Camera/Matrix perspective transformations.

steps.title: Implement 3D Depth Extrusion Layers
steps.description: Formulate consecutive mathematical ring drawing routines in Clock3DView, offsetting layers based on projection factors to build an extruded 3D bevel.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic 3D Shadow Cast Projection
steps.description: Introduce secondary canvas drawing vectors shifting dropshadows in the exact opposite direction of simulated light sources.

steps.title: Implement Circular Dial Setting Gestures
steps.description: Incorporate custom mathematical touch mechanics translating radial user swipes into precise minute coordinates for Timer mode.

steps.title: Formulate Visual Style Themes
steps.description: Build theme palettes supporting distinct rim gradients, dials, steampunk rotating gears, tick sweeps, and roman numeral maps.

steps.title: Integrate Physical Accelerometer Inertia Physics
steps.description: Bind hardware sensor listeners inside MainActivity, translating gravitational pull into fluid 3D parallax shifts.

steps.title: Implement Precision Chronograph Logic
steps.description: Configure stopwatch sweep calculations and sub-dial high frequency millisecond hands displaying rapid mechanical rotations.

steps.title: Implement Wedge Timer Sweep Logic
steps.description: Write count down sweep wedges filling inner dial sectors with vibrant glowing progress matrices.

steps.title: Harmonize Interactive Main Thread Callbacks
steps.description: Synchronize Clock3DView ticks, callback hooks, dashboard digital readouts, and haptic triggers within MainActivity.

steps.title: Perform Strict Compilation Compatibility Validations
steps.description: Analyze Java files for syntax rules, validating complete package alignment, correct namespaces, and strict Java 8 structures.

steps.title: Building 3D Clock
steps.description: Execute final build verification checks and package files into the final distribution ready structure.
